desc:
CHRISTMAS UPDATE COMING SOON! New items, minigames and more! Thank you for playing my game! 

Welcome new tenant! The neighbors here are.. lovely. Sometimes they knock on your door at night! Make sure you check the peephole before you let them in... 

🛋️ Decorate your dream apartment
🚪 Spot the fakes before you open the door
🐾 Adopt a pet (they don't like the fakes either)
❤️ Get likes on your home and climb the leaderboard
🌙 Survive the night

This game is new! Thanks so much for playing! Be prepared, the game may restart for updates <3 Please consider giving a thumbs up if you enjoyed it and stay tuned for more!
